comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked against a measured table: the same household as wages-and-child-single with the child answered as HAVING another living biological parent and the parents' situation answered `other`. That single answer closes the dictionary's benefit-split gate (`parentsAreDivorcedSeparatedOrLivingApart` is "not other"), so the child is claimed under the ordinary qualifying-child rules and every served line is the baseline to the cent — asserted line for line against wages-and-child-single, which is what makes this a gate that decides whether the return computes rather than a figure. Earlier, the whole population was refused outright.
